stem.text: Prokaryotes and eukaryotes use extracellular enzymes.
Extracellular digestive enzymes are found in the external environments of some prokaryotes.
Some prokaryotes are digested by hydrolytic enzymes during phagocytosis by eukaryotic cells.
Which row shows the locations where extracellular enzymes are produced?
